summary.zh: 全面 5% 暴击、把智力转成攻击强度，再用萨满专注止住震击的法力消耗。
summary.en: 5% critical strike with everything, Intellect turned into Attack Power, and Shamanistic Focus so shocks stop draining your Mana.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，用武器附魔与震击打近战
scenario.en: Levels 10–20, melee with a weapon buff and shocks

pros.zh: 雷鸣猛击让所有法术与攻击的暴击几率提高 5%。
pros.en: Thundering Strikes adds 5% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks.

pros.zh: 聪慧把 100% 智力转化为攻击强度，早期捡到的施法锁甲也因此值得穿。
pros.en: Mental Dexterity converts 100% of your Intellect into Attack Power, which makes the caster mail you find early worth wearing.

pros.zh: 萨满专注让震击系法术与闪电之盾的法力消耗降低 45%。
pros.en: Shamanistic Focus cuts 45% of the Mana cost of your Shock spells and Lightning Shield.

pros.zh: 强化幽魂之狼让幽魂之狼施法时间缩短 3 秒，并且可以在室内使用。
pros.en: Improved Ghost Wolf reduces the Ghost Wolf cast time by 3 seconds and lets it be used indoors.

pros.zh: 强化闪电之盾是这 3 点的另一个选择，但它在天赋树后续没有通向关键天赋。
pros.en: Improved Lightning Shield is the other candidate for those three points, but it does not lead anywhere useful deeper in the tree.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
